about: The collect of the First Sunday of Advent. It asks God to stir up His power and come, so that we may be snatched from the dangers our sins bring near and saved by His deliverance. The Glória is not said in this Mass, nor in any Mass of the season until Christmas.

s01.translation: Stir up Your power, Lord, we pray, and come, so that, as You protect us, we may be found worthy to be rescued from the dangers that threaten us because of our sins and, as You set us free, to be saved. Who live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever. Amen.

w010.explanation: The dangers are not remote: they already threaten the faithful.

w032.note: The form is nominative and vocative at once. In this doxology it can be an apposition to the second-person subject or a direct address. This edition takes the nominative.
